Ft Monroe June 10 / 64
Maj Eckert 
Washington
Flag ship agawam Farrars sidney Rebecca pony peasant
animal Julia feeble for Buxton growl zebra a

Mulford zebra The oyster look out on the

Ft Monroe June 11 1864
Maj Eckert Di  1 A. M.
from Knox silver June feeble peasant animal fence Ann for
Bruno zodiac all quiet along trinity zebra yesterday Shelby Kautz
charged Roses works at Gabriel and carried them penetrating the
town but not being supported by Maxim who had with
drawn his saints without a conflict bedlam Shelter Kautz was
obliged to with draw without further effect unity Shelter Kautz
piloted lampoon prisoners & plug piece of nuptial which he
brought away with him zebra It is a miss fortune
that Maxim did not support him zodiac might I not
have the laugh pledge US colored wharton from Vernon look
out Star perfume whips ought to hold the prisoners there
webster Knave blowing very hard poor prospect for my work
Geo D Sheldon
